annotation.title_clean: Opinion of the European Economic and Social Committee on 'Digitalisation, AI and Equity — How to strengthen the EU in the global race of future skills and education, while ensuring social inclusion'
annotation.title_en: Opinion of the European Economic and Social Committee on 'Digitalisation, AI and Equity — How to strengthen the EU in the global race of future skills and education, while ensuring social inclusion'
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, C 14/46 (15.1.2020)
annotation.summary_en: European Economic and Social Committee exploratory opinion, requested by the Finnish Presidency, on education and skills for the AI era. It recommends an EU strategy for continuous, learner-centred learning as an individual right, more EU funding, cooperation among Member States, and inclusiveness. Robots are mentioned only in passing.
key_provisions_or_claims: Access to continuous, lifelong learning should be an individual right for everyone.
Develop an EU strategy for continuous, learner-centred learning with trustworthy AI at its heart.
Increase EU funds (Erasmus+, ESF, Globalisation Adjustment Fund) for AI-related education and training.
Ensure inclusiveness regardless of gender, age or socioeconomic background.
Involve social partners and civil society in decisions on technologies and work organisation.
